question: Does hipMemcpyAsync from PAGEABLE host memory drain the stream (CUDA documents that it does)? The D8 staging fix is only a win if it does not.
method: enqueue seconds-scale memset work on stream 0, then time one KB-scale H2D upload: A sync hipMemcpy (production path), B async pageable (candidate), C async pinned (reference), D async pageable with an empty queue (floor). Verify landed bytes after a drain for B and C.
verdict: ROCm stages pageable memory during the async call: B is 1600x cheaper than the sync copy with the same deep queue and equals pinned, so wiring enqueue_host_to_device needs no pinned slots, no double-buffering and no source-lifetime machinery for temporary pageable arrays (covered by test_enqueue_host_to_device_consumes_a_temporary_pageable_source).
